import: import { AppShell, AppShellHeader, AppShellPane, AppShellAction, AppShellAccount } from "@zen-ds/react";

components.name: AppShell
components.description:
The frame of an app, built on Figma's AppShell patterns (◇ Master-Layout 16254:1057): Pattern/AppShell/Desktop
(16258:1857) from 1024px, Pattern/AppShell/Mobile (16261:136204) below it when a mobile part is given, with a
"Skip to content" link, a modal navigation drawer and a docked or modal side panel.

Desktop (`pattern`): Sidebar, Header/AppShell (`header`, an AppShellHeader), the Body (`children`, padded
Margin-Comfortable), the panes (`leadingPane`, `trailingPane`, AppShellPane), `progress`, `sidePanel` and
`floatingActions`. Mobile (`mobileTop`): the TopNavigation, the band's `hero` or the `backdrop`, the Body, then the
`bottomNavigation` or the `actionBar`. The Sidebar, the header, the panes and the bars stay in view while the page
scrolls (the window or the frame around the shell).

  <AppShell sidebar={<Sidebar … />} header={<AppShellHeader leading={<Breadcrumbs … />} actions={…} main={<PageHeader … />} />}>
    …the page…
  </AppShell>

props.name: pattern
props.description:
Figma Layout, the desktop structure (from 1024px: desktops and iPad landscape):
- `sidebar` (default): Sidebar · header + page · docked side panel.
- `list-detail`: the Sidebar's rail · `leadingPane` (a 360 list) · header + the selected item.
- `top-bar`: no Sidebar; the header across, its sections or centre holding the navigation.
- `workspace`: the header across the top · `leadingPane` · page · `trailingPane` (tools, properties).
- `docs`: as workspace, the page a centred 720 column for reading, the panes on the Canvas.
- `focus`: one task: the header across · `progress` · a 680 column with the `trailingPane` (a summary) beside it.

props.name: collapse
props.description:
Figma Collapse: where the Sidebar's collapse toggle sits. `header` (default): at the start of the header's top row ·
`sidebar`: in the Sidebar's own header, for a trail that starts with a Master crumb (two icons in a row clash) ·
`none`: no toggle (the rail follows `sidebarCollapsed` or `useAppShell().setSidebarCollapsed`).

props.name: sidebar
props.description:
Figma Sidebar: the app's navigation, a <Sidebar> (the `sidebar` and `list-detail` patterns). From 1024px it sits
beside the page, expanded or collapsed to its rail; narrower, it opens as a modal drawer from the header's menu
button or `useAppShell().openNav()`. A Sidebar wrapped in a component of your own follows the shell too.

props.name: header
props.description: Figma Header/AppShell: the page's header, an <AppShellHeader> (top row, Main row, Sections). Sticks to the top.

props.name: leadingPane
props.description: Figma Leading-Pane: an <AppShellPane> before the page (`list-detail` 360; `workspace`, `docs` Sidebar/Default-Width).

props.name: trailingPane
props.description: Figma Trailing-Pane: an <AppShellPane> after the page (`workspace`, `docs` Sidebar/Default-Width; `focus` 376).

props.name: sidePanel
props.description:
Figma Side-Panel: a right panel docked beside the page, usually <SidePanel type="standard">. It docks while the page
keeps a Tablet width (744px) beside it; otherwise a SidePanel opens as the modal panel.

props.name: progress
props.description: Figma Progress (`focus`): the task's steps under the header, usually a horizontal <Stepper>, centred.

props.name: floatingActions
props.description: Figma Floating-Actions: the page's floating buttons in the bottom-right corner, Margin-Comfortable from the edges.

props.name: banner
props.description: A full-width message strip above the whole shell, usually <AlertBanner> (trial ending, maintenance, offline).

props.name: canvas
props.description: Page background layer: default Canvas, alt (a white page) or flat (pair it with Sidebar background="flat").

props.name: mobileTop
props.description:
Figma Pattern/AppShell/Mobile Top, the mobile structure (under 1024px: phones and iPad portrait):
- `bar` (default): the TopNavigation on Surface/Alt over the page.
- `band`: a Support/Brand/Subtle band with the TopNavigation (transparent) and the `hero`, then the page.
- `band-sheet`: the band fills the screen and the page rises over it as a sheet with 3XLarge top corners.
- `media`: a `backdrop` (photo, video, map) behind a liquid-overlay TopNavigation, the page as a sheet over it.

props.name: band
props.description:
Mobile `band` / `band-sheet`: the band's fill (user, 2026-10-19). `subtle` Support/Brand/Subtle (default, the
pattern's own), `pale` Support/Brand/Pale, `soft` Support/Brand/Soft, `accent` Background/Accent/Solid. On `accent`
the TopNavigation takes `transparent-on-color` (unless it sets a type) and the hero's text takes `tone="on-accent"`
(content follows its Solid fill).

props.name: topNavigation
props.description: Mobile: the screen's <TopNavigation> (its h1, Back on a child screen, up to three actions). Its type follows `mobileTop` unless it sets one.

props.name: hero
props.description: Mobile Figma Hero (`band`, `band-sheet`): what the band shows under the TopNavigation (a balance, a profile, a summary).

props.name: backdrop
props.description: Mobile Figma Backdrop (`media`): the photo, video or map behind the top of the screen.

props.name: bottomNavigation
props.description: Mobile Figma Bottom Tab-Bar | Floating: the root navigation, a <BottomNavigation> (`floating-glass` floats over the page). Root screens only.

props.name: actionBar
props.description: Mobile Figma Bottom Actions: the screen's actions pinned to the bottom, an <ActionBar> (`surface="glass"` over photos).

props.name: sidebarCollapsed
props.description: Sidebar rail state when controlled; pair it with `onSidebarCollapsedChange`.

props.name: defaultSidebarCollapsed
props.description: Rail state to start from, uncontrolled. Default: the Sidebar's own `collapsed`; `list-detail` starts on the rail.

props.name: onSidebarCollapsedChange
props.description: Called when the toggle (or `useAppShell().setSidebarCollapsed`) collapses or expands the Sidebar. Store it to keep the choice between visits.

props.name: navOpen
props.description: Drawer state when controlled (drawer and mobile layouts).

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation drawer. Default: the localized "Navigation".

props.name: mainId
props.description: Id of the main element, the target of the skip link.

props.name: layout
props.description:
Which structure to draw: `auto` (default) follows the shell's own width (1024px and up desktop; narrower, `mobile`
when a mobile part is given, else `drawer`), or force `desktop`, `drawer` or `mobile` (a design canvas, a preview).

props.name: children
props.description: Figma Content: the page (the Body pads Margin-Comfortable; Spacing/Gap/XSmall on desktop, Layout-Mobile/Section-Gap on mobile).

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides, by layer (`{ Close: { level: "secondary" } }`). Written by Zen Studio; app code sets the props.

props.name: ref
props.description: The root `<div>` element.

components.name: AppShellHeader
components.description:
Figma Header/AppShell (16243:290461), the header of Pattern/AppShell/Desktop. The Main frame pads Margin-Comfortable
above and at the sides and Spacing/Padding/XSmall below, Spacing/Gap/Medium between its rows:
- Top-Header: the Sidebar's collapse toggle (Collapse Button: a Button/Icon-Flat Small Primary in a 20px wrapper, while
  the AppShell has `collapse="header"`) or, on a narrow shell, the menu button that opens the navigation drawer; then
  Top-Elements: `leading` · `center` · `actions` (Primitives/Dashboard/Header Type=Navigation), Spacing/Gap/Medium apart.
- Main-Element: `main`, the page's own header.
Under the Main frame, Sections: `sections`. Pass it as the AppShell's `header`; on a phone the shell shows its
`topNavigation` instead.

props.name: leading
props.description: Figma Top-Elements › Leading-Slots: where the user is, usually `<Breadcrumbs size="sm">`, or a Search. It grows.

props.name: center
props.description: Figma Center-Slots: the row's middle, up to 400px and centred between `leading` and `actions`, e.g. a Search.

props.name: actions
props.description:
Figma Trailing-Slots, Spacing/Gap/Small apart: a plan Badge, `AppShellAction` buttons (notifications, help), then
the account (`<Menu trigger={<AppShellAccount … />}>`). Page actions belong in `main`.

props.name: main
props.description: Figma Main-Element (the Main row): the page's own header, usually `<PageHeader title=… />` with its actions.

props.name: sections
props.description: Figma Sections: rows under the Main row, e.g. `<Tabs>` for the page's views or a toolbar of Search + filters.

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides, by layer (`{ Collapse: { level: "secondary" } }`). Written by Zen Studio.

props.name: ref
props.description: The root `<header>` element.

components.name: AppShellPane
components.description:
Figma .Primitives/AppShell/Pane (16254:1099): a side pane of Pattern/AppShell/Desktop (List-Detail's list, Workspace's
and Docs' leading and trailing panes, Focus' summary). Corner-Radius/XLarge; Pane-Header pads Margin-Compact at the
top and sides and Spacing/Padding/XSmall below, Spacing/Gap/XSmall between the title and the action; Pane-Content pads
Spacing/Padding/XSmall with Spacing/Gap/XSmall between its rows. The AppShell sizes it (`leadingPane`, `trailingPane`).

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Title (Heading/3, Content/Neutral/Strongest, one line, cut with "…"): the pane's heading and its region name.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the title. Default 2: a pane sits beside the page's h1.

props.name: action
props.description:
Figma Action: one icon action at the end of the header, usually
`<IconButton appearance="flat" level="secondary" size="sm" …>` (a 20px glyph with a 32px hit area).

props.name: theme
props.description:
Figma Theme (Card's Neutral themes): `shadow` Surface + Shadow/Bottom/Level-1 (default) · `flat` · `border`
Border/Neutral/Pale · `pale` Support/Neutral/Pale · `subtle` Support/Neutral/Subtle (both with the Overlay blur) ·
`on-container` Surface/Flat, for a pane on a container · `canvas` no fill, for reading layouts (Docs).

props.name: surface
props.description: Figma Surface for the flat and border themes: `default` Surface/Default · `alt` Surface/Alt · `flat` Surface/Flat (border only).

props.name: children
props.description: Figma Pane-Content: the pane's body (a List, a tree, filters, a summary).

props.name: overrides
props.description: Figma instance overrides by layer. Written by Zen Studio; app code sets the props.

props.name: ref
props.description: The root `<section>` element.

components.name: AppShellAction
components.description:
Figma Primitives/Dashboard/Header/Action-Item (12280:19532): a header icon action with an optional
Primitives/Notification-Dot (4116:21789). Dot 8px, Number Badge/Size/2XSmall high with Label/Small/Medium text, both on
Color/Background/{Negative|Positive|Accent}/Solid with a 2px Color/Border/Inverse ring, at the button's top-right.
It forwards its ref and props to the button, so it can be a <Menu trigger>.

props.name: icon
props.description: Figma Leading-Icon: an icon name (`"icon-bell-01-line"`) or a node.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The action's name (“Notifications”): its accessible name, with the unread count added, and its 1s tooltip.

props.name: count
props.description: Figma Noti-type=Number: the unread count on a badge. 0 hides it; above 99 it reads "99+" (the accessible name keeps the exact number).

props.name: dot
props.description: Figma Noti-type=Dot: something new without a count. Hidden while a count shows.

props.name: tone
props.description: Figma Notification-Dot Theme: `default` Negative (needs attention) · `active` Positive · `accent`.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Figma Theme: `tertiary` (Button/Icon-Main Medium Tertiary, 40px) · `flat` (Button/Icon-Flat Medium Primary: a 20px glyph with a 40px hit area).

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip text. Default: `aria-label` (without the count).

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the icon button it draws, by layer (`{ Button: { level: "secondary" } }`). Written by Zen Studio;
 app code sets icon / appearance.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the icon button element, so the action can be a `<Menu trigger>`.

components.name: AppShellAccount
components.description:
The account button at the end of the header's top row: Figma Avatar/Single Circle Medium (Image-Size/Medium) as a
button. Put it in a Menu for the account actions: `<Menu align="end" trigger={<AppShellAccount name="Ava Chen" src={photo} />} items={…} />`.
Keyboard focus shows the Avatar's own focus ring.

props.name: name
props.description: The signed-in person's name: the accessible name (“Account: Ava Chen”), the tooltip and the initials without a photo.

props.name: src
props.description: Photo URL (Figma Avatar/Single Theme=Photo).

props.name: theme
props.description: Initials colour without a photo. Default neutral.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the avatar it draws, by layer (`{ Avatar: { shape: "square" } }`). Written by Zen Studio;
 app code sets src / theme.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the account button element, so it can be a `<Menu trigger>`.
